description: Delete a sandbox IMMEDIATELY and IRREVERSIBLY (running or paused): all files, installed packages, background tasks and memory are lost and cannot be recovered — download_file anything you need first. Billing stops; the final partial period is billed (ephemeral per second with the 60 s minimum, persistent per started hour). Requires: token.

sandbox_id.description: Sandbox id as returned by create_sandbox / list_sandboxes, e.g. "sb_3f2a…".

name: kill_sandbox
title: Delete a sandbox
